name: blindkey
description: Local credential broker for AI agents: run allowed commands with secrets the agent never sees.
long_description: Blindkey keeps credentials in a local encrypted vault. `blindkey mcp` exposes two tools: `list_handles` (metadata only) and `use_handle` (status only). The secret is injected at the destination you allowed and never returned to the model. Approvals happen on a `blindkey agent run` broker in your terminal; with no broker running, `use_handle` fails closed. No server, no account, no proxy.

tools.name: list_handles
tools.description: List the handles you allowed (metadata only, never values).

tools.name: use_handle
tools.description: Deliver a handle's secret to an allowed destination; returns status only.
